info.title: Community Connect API
info.description: Secure REST and realtime backend for events, communities, chat, AI, wallet, notifications, and disputes. Every operation includes request and response schemas, accepted enum values for constrained fields, and examples. Money is represented in integer kobo.

post.description: Requires an owned pending order and Idempotency-Key; takes no body. Reconciles every saved Paystack reference server-side before returning a verified checkout URL or confirming payment. In-progress or uncertain payments return PAYMENT_STILL_PROCESSING; expired, cancelled, refunded, unreserved orders, and orders at the eight-attempt safety limit return TICKET_ORDER_NOT_RETRYABLE. A replacement attempt keeps the same order and reservation, and later duplicate charges are tracked for refund.
